result.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
result.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 Pass@(K,T) 从采样广度与交互深度两方面分析多回合 agentic RL 的收益来源，发现其优势集中在错误恢复与长程韧性且依赖充足回合预算，并提出训练中变化交互预算的 BudgetMix RL。
AI.relevance_reason: 其回合预算依赖分析与训练期预算混合，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡、停止决策及预算或长度泛化提供可核查线索；但该工作针对纯文本 agent，与视觉状态和 latent 推理的联系尚待确认。
